feeds.title: Heartspun Quilts
feeds.description: I invite you to browse my website and get to know me a bit better. You'll find that I'm a traditional quilter using traditional blocks, fabrics, and colors constructed with today's modern piecing techniques. You'll find large quilt patterns, small quilt patterns using charm packs, and others that can use Moda Layer Cakes.

feeds.title: O'Quilts Blog
feeds.description: I have been quilting since 1973. Thank you grandma for teaching me how to sew...you have saved my life so many times:) I was born in Boston, raised in Arizona, lived 1 year in France, 2 years in England, 2 years in NYC, 2 years in LA, 20 years in Miami, Florida and now living for in Charlotte, North Carolina since 1994.

feeds.title: Tamarack Shack Blog
feeds.description: This blog is where I share photos of my quilts as well as my clients quilts. I have been quilting for over 20 years and have turned my passion for quilting into a home business. Tamarack Shack Longarm Quilting opened it's doors is January 2009 on the shores of Schist Lake in Northern Manitoba.

feeds.title: My Joyful Journey
feeds.description: I've been sewing since I was 10, learning in Girl Scouts. Once I found quilting, in the mid-1980's, all other crafts went out the window. Quiltmaking is my passion.

feeds.title: Textile Time Travels Blog
feeds.description: Have Quilts, Will Travel. Love sharing my amazing antique quilt collection in trunk shows, classes, patterns, etc. I'd love to share them with you.

feeds.title: Ann Quilts
feeds.description: I am a professional quilt restorer and a quilt artist and author of ''Preserving Our Quilt Legacy: Giving Antique Quilts the Special Care They Deserve'

feeds.title: Quilting...for the Rest of Us Blog
feeds.description: I am a traditional quilter, a modern quilter, and an art quilter. I've gotten into hand-dyeing, spinning, and needle-felting. I do whatever catches my fancy at any given moment with no regard to categories or definitions. I have a passion for encouraging others and empowering their sense of personal creativity. Run by Sandy.

feeds.title: Dragonfly Quilts Blog
feeds.description: Maggie Balll's web site show her traditional quilts, her Mongolia trips as well as offering her unique patterns and books for sale.

feeds.title: Quilts-Vintage and Antique Blog
feeds.description: I love quilts, I make quilts, I collect antique quilts, I teach quilting, I restore antique quilts, I study quilts, I give talks on quilts, I travel to see quilts, I take classes on quilting. I have a wonderful husband, three great kids, and seven beautiful grandkids.

feeds.title: Hanne's Quilt Corner
feeds.description: Always curious, always seeking and enjoying challenges in quilting, embroidery, knitting and crochet.

feeds.title: Repro quilt Lover Blog
feeds.description: Discover the art of quilting with Repro quilt Lover that delves into techniques like mastering tiny nine-patch blocks and piecing quilts on point. Explore the joy of quilting with simple tips for creating your perfect quilt journal and crafting easy yet beautiful patterns like the 'Christmas Glow' table runner. Dive into projects like reproducing antique quilts and mastering classic blocks like the Ohio Star with our free tutorials.
